title: The Vietnam Binh Chau (Chau Tan) Late Tang Wreck
summary: Archaeological discovery of a Late Tang dynasty shipwreck off Vietnam's Binh Chau coast, featuring exceptionally valuable wood priced at US$360/kg, providing significant insights into 9th century maritime trade between China and Southeast Asia.
problem_solved: Presents archaeological evidence of ancient maritime trade routes and valuable commodities from the Tang dynasty period
why_valuable: Offers rare physical evidence of Tang dynasty maritime commerce and the high-value wood commodities traded in that era
